instruction: Draw a regular hexagon with side length 6 centered at the origin in the default zero-rotation orientation, then move the whole hexagon 30 mm to the right so its final center is at (30, 0). In the final orientation, one vertex must lie on the positive X side at (36, 0), the opposite vertex at (24, 0), and the remaining vertices at approximately (33, 5.196152), (27, 5.196152), (27, -5.196152), and (33, -5.196152). Connect those vertices with exactly six straight outer edges to form one closed regular hexagon. Do not rotate it into a different orientation. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
